name: Algeria
contextBlurb: Algeria treats stablecoins within a broad virtual-currency prohibition. There is no licensed private stablecoin regime, and domestic issuance, holding, purchase, sale or use is generally banned.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Algeria treats stablecoins within a broad virtual-currency prohibition. There is no licensed private stablecoin regime, and domestic issuance, holding, purchase, sale or use is generally banned.
stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Stablecoins are not separately defined; they fall within the practical scope of Algeria's virtual-currency prohibition.

regulators.name: Bank of Algeria
regulators.role: Central bank and payments authority in a jurisdiction where virtual-currency use is broadly prohibited.
